Name: Jashub, Son of Issachar
Summary: Son of Issachar, named among the four sons of Issachar.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:1: Son of Issachar, named among the four sons of Issachar.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jashub stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
